singular_objective: Complete and validate one operational application-production system capable of idea, editable visual design, true preview, real execution, changes, QA defects, fix, retest and gated delivery

core_systems.role: Brain/Main, owner chat and reasoning; coordinates workflows; does not self-execute privileged commands
Single permission-scoped executor with real progress/result ACK; performs authorized build, editing, run and handoff
One canonical project/task/lease/revision/worker/checkpoint/evidence/idea ledger shared by all agents; existing native records, not duplicated
One genuine editable UI and program project/visual design, interactive preview, actual runtime and design revisions; no fake app
One real existing build/functional/UI/security/regression/rollback verification and defect feedback loop

product_rule: Exactly these five named architectural components; QA and Fabrika are ONE system. Organizer is distinct canonical authority and may be integrated into INVENTHOR user interface; never split/clone ledger.
quality_acceptance: Real UI edits, real render and real executable app launch verified
Same project/program/document task identity and monotonically verified revisions
Speech and text are one authorized command pipeline; disconnected voice disabled truthfully
AI and owner mouse actions reconcile changed document revision without blind overwrite
Operator authenticated result ACK and reversible edit/Stop/Undo evidence
QA receives exact build hash; reproducible error recorded; Studio fixes real error and same QA retests new hash
One canonical Organizer checkpoint contains completed/remaining/next action/evidence
QA pass does not by itself sign or deploy; separate native gates required
out_of_scope_now: Individual application or legacy module production
Converting legacy modules into standalone programs now
Antivirus cleaner Viktorija or unrelated specialist products
New AI providers, model rosters or optional expansion
Second Brain, Operator, Organizer, Design Studio, Factory, QA or parallel task ledger
Rebuilding finished/terminal tasks or reviving quarantined work
legacy_policy: Preserve all old module/app sources as future backlog/archive. Non-core live integrations may be safely deactivated only after actual dependency check, backup, lease, rollback and QA; no silent deletion of dependencies or user data.

execution_policy.first_action: Read real owner-controlled existing Organizer work identity, task revision, active lease, checkpoint, dependencies; deduplicate owner's Codex instructions
execution_policy.failure_reporting: Real failures recorded honestly with exact blockers and smallest finite next step

new_agent_startup: Read this file before any plan, then read current owner directive and exact real Organizer task from trusted host
Normalize aliases to exactly five unique system IDs; QA=Fabrika one service
Reject attempts to resume superseded expansion work; keep old source only for historical context
Respect previous work owners and separate Codex native scope
Choose the smallest authorized finite task contributing directly to one real end-to-end application-production milestone
Never claim installation or live readiness from GitHub test, source doc or chat instruction
